title: Tokenization: Hardness and Bicriteria Approximation Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2611.15074v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study Binary Tokenization: given a corpus of binary strings over $\{0,1\}$ and a vocabulary budget $K$, select at most $K$ substrings (called vocabulary) to minimize the total number of tokens needed to represent the corpus. The primitive symbols $0$ and $1$ are always available, and each document must be segmented separately. Letting $n$ denote the total corpus length and $M$ for the maximum document length, we prove that, for every fixed $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$, Binary Tokenization problem does not have polynomial-time $n^{1-\varepsilon}$-approximation algorithms unless $\mathsf{P}=\mathsf{NP}$. To complement the hardness result, we give a polynomial-time $(\gamma,\gamma)$-bicriteria algorithm, with $\gamma = \sqrt{M}\log n$: The algorithm outputs a vocabulary of size at most $\gamma K$ with number of tokens at most $\gamma {\rm OPT}_K$, where ${\rm OPT}_K$ is the optimal number of tokens under the original budget $K$. translated_title: 词元化：困难性与双准则近似算法
translated_abstract: 我们研究二元词元化问题：给定一个由{0,1}上的二元字符串构成的语料库和词汇表预算K，需选择至多K个子串（称为词汇表），以最小化表示该语料库所需的词元总数。基本符号0和1始终可用，且每个文档必须单独分割。设n表示语料库总长度，M表示最大文档长度，我们证明：对于任意固定的ε∈(0,1)，除非P=NP，二元词元化问题不存在多项式时间的n^(1-ε)-近似算法。作为对这一困难性结果的补充，我们给出了一个多项式时间的(γ,γ)-双准则算法，其中γ=√M·log n：该算法输出一个大小至多为γK的词汇表，其词元数至多为γ·OPT_K，其中OPT_K是在原始预算K下的最优词元数。我们还研究了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明了二元词元化问题除非P=NP否则不存在多项式时间的n^(1-ε)近似算法，同时给出了一个(√M·log n, √M·log n)双准则多项式时间近似算法，即以不超过√M·log n倍的词汇表预算获得不超过√M·log n倍最优值的词元数。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that Binary Tokenization admits no polynomial-time n^(1-ε)-approximation unless P=NP, and complements this hardness with a polynomial-time (√M log n, √M log n)-bicriteria approximation algorithm that uses at most γK vocabulary entries to achieve at most γ·OPT_K tokens.
